xp_curve.note: xp to reach level L = floor(base * (growth^(L-1) - 1) / (growth - 1)); L2=100, L10=1275, L30=11356, L60=143679

skills.name: Forestry
skills.desc: Fell trees for logs. Feeds Joinery and Hearth fuel.

skills.name: Mining
skills.desc: Break ore and coal from outcrops. Feeds Smithing.

skills.name: Angling
skills.desc: Fish the fen pools and rivers. Feeds Cooking.

skills.name: Foraging
skills.desc: Gather fenroot, reeds and fungi. Feeds Brewing and Joinery (fibre).

skills.name: Smithing
skills.desc: Smelt bars and forge tools and blades. Tools wear out, so smiths are always in demand.

skills.name: Joinery
skills.desc: Turn logs and fibre into planks, handles, rods and bows.

skills.name: Cooking
skills.desc: Cook fish and stews that restore Vitality in a fight.

skills.name: Brewing
skills.desc: Brew tonics from fen herbs: temporary skill and combat boosts.

skills.name: Attack
skills.desc: Accuracy: how often your blows land. Needed to wield daggers, swords and battle axes (stab / slash). Trains in the Accurate style.

skills.name: Strength
skills.desc: Max hit: how hard you hit. Needed to wield maces and warhammers (crush, armour breakers). Trains in the Aggressive style.

skills.name: Defence
skills.desc: Blocking: enemies hit you less often. Needed to wear armour. Trains a little every time an enemy swings at you; a full same-tier armour set multiplies it.

skills.name: Vitality
skills.desc: Your health pool. Trains alongside every combat skill.

skills.name: Archery
skills.desc: Bows: accuracy and max hit with a bow. Needed to wield bows. Range 5 tiles with line of sight; each shot uses one arrow. Trains in the Ranged style.

skills.name: Prayer
skills.desc: Bury bones to train. Prayer effects arrive in a later milestone.
